# Documentation Engineering for Google Apps Script

## Purpose

Engineer canonical technical documentation, ADRs, runbooks, handoff guides, release notes, source/evidence status, generated AI-readable docs such as llms.txt/MCP indexes, and reproducible benchmark documentation. Use when the deliverable is durable engineering knowledge or operational documentation. Use for ADR architecture decision records, runbooks, handoff, and reproducible engineering evidence.

## Workflow

1. Identify the task boundary and the smallest relevant reference topic.
2. Read only the reference files needed for the current task.
3. Apply durable rules before relying on volatile platform facts.
4. Re-check current official sources for time-sensitive behavior.
5. Cross-reference neighboring playbook skills when ownership crosses boundaries.
